literal: Difficult alas [is] consolation even from the wise, separation in one situation because of [its] reality.
translation: Because separation is an undeniable reality in this situation, finding consolation is difficult, alas, even from the wise.
modern: பிரிவு என்பது ஒரு நிலையில் உண்மையாக நடப்பதால், அறிவுடையவர்களால் கூட எனக்கு ஆறுதல் கூறுவது கடினமாக இருக்கிறது.
explanation: The speaker expresses the deep pain of parting from her lover. She notes that because the separation is an undeniable reality, no words of comfort can soothe her. Even the wise, who usually know how to console a grieving heart, find it difficult to offer any effective assurance in the face of this actual separation. The word 'தேற்றம்' means clarity or consolation, which is rendered impossible by the sheer fact ('உண்மையான்') of his leaving.
